scope: The routine executes completely in the original (0x4eb5c0 and 0x4ec1d0 run unchanged) with 0x4e7c90 and 0x4ec0e0 stubbed and logged; generated S3M patterns cover every command letter and parameter form, key off, empty and invalid notes, out-of-range volumes, truncated data, remapped and skipped channels, more than 32 channels and allocation failures. Odd cases reach the row buffer and map through the globals reader and the 0xf0000000 store pseudo call (the lifted host path). Every call with its registers, the returned eax, the record, the packed output, the row buffer with the parameter memory and the inputs compare.
